lines.text: Why can't it reach your hand? Somewhere, nearly half its bounce disappeared.
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ kˈænt ɪt ɹˈiːtʃ jʊɹ hˈænd? sˈʌmwɛɹ, nˌɪɹli hˈæf ɪts bˈaʊns dˌɪsɐpˈɪɹd.

lines.text: One meter down. Fifty-six centimeters back up. Then thirty-two. Then eighteen. Each bounce keeps just over half its height.
lines.phonemes: wˈʌn mˈiːɾɚ dˈaʊn. fˈɪftisˈɪks sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz bˈæk ˈʌp. ðˈɛn θˈɜːɾitˈuː. ðˈɛn ˈeɪtiːn. ˈiːtʃ bˈaʊns kˈiːps dʒˈʌst ˌoʊvɚ hˈæf ɪts hˈaɪt.

lines.text: Look closer. The knock: a puff of sound. The ball squashes, and doesn't quite spring back.
lines.phonemes: lˈʊk klˈoʊsɚ. ðə nˈɑːk: ɐ pˈʌf ʌv sˈaʊnd. ðə bˈɔːl skwˈɑːʃᵻz, ænd dˈʌzənt kwˈaɪt spɹˈɪŋ bˈæk.

lines.text: We call that energy lost. James Joule wouldn't. In the eighteen-forties, he let falling weights turn a paddle in water, and the water warmed. Energy doesn't vanish. It becomes heat, shaking and sound, spread too thin to see.
lines.phonemes: wiː kˈɔːl ðæt ˈɛnɚdʒi lˈɔst. dʒˈeɪmz ʤˈuːl wˈʊdənt. ɪnðɪ ˈeɪtiːnfˈɔːɹɾiz, hiː lˈɛt fˈɔːlɪŋ wˈeɪts tˈɜːn ɐ pˈædəl ɪn wˈɔːɾɚ, ænd ðə wˈɔːɾɚ wˈɔːɹmd. ˈɛnɚdʒi dˈʌzənt vˈænɪʃ. ɪt bɪkˌʌmz hˈiːt, ʃˈeɪkɪŋ ænd sˈaʊnd, spɹˈɛd tˈuː θˈɪn tə sˈiː.

lines.text: Balance it on a basketball. Drop both together. The basketball hands over most of its bounce. The tennis ball rockets past your hand.
lines.phonemes: bˈæləns ɪɾ ˌɔn ɐ bˈæskɪtbˌɔːl. dɹˈɑːp bˈoʊθ təɡˈɛðɚ. ðə bˈæskɪtbˌɔːl hˈændz ˌoʊvɚ mˈoʊst əv ɪts bˈaʊns. ðə tˈɛnɪs bˈɔːl ɹˈɑːkɪts pˈæst jʊɹ hˈænd.

lines.text: Measure it: those missing forty-four centimeters? A quarter of a joule. Even if it all stays in the ball, two thousandths of a degree.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛʒɚɹ ɪt: ðoʊz mˈɪsɪŋ fˈɔːɹɾifˈɔːɹ sˈɛntɪmˌiːɾɚz? ɐ kwˈɔːɹɾɚɹ əvə ʤˈuːl . ˈiːvən ɪf ɪɾ ˈɔːl stˈeɪz ɪnðə bˈɔːl, tˈuː θˈaʊzəndθs əvə dᵻɡɹˈiː.

lines.text: A bounce never destroys energy. It gives it away, knock by knock.
lines.phonemes: ɐ bˈaʊns nˈɛvɚ dᵻstɹˈɔɪz ˈɛnɚdʒi. ɪt ɡˈɪvz ɪɾ ɐwˈeɪ, nˈɑːk baɪ nˈɑːk.

lines.text: Next: a hammer, a feather, the Moon. Nobody wins.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ hˈæmɚ, ɐ fˈɛðɚ, ðə mˈuːn. nˈoʊbɑːdi wˈɪnz.
